standard-dialogue.text: If the player is not wearing an amulet of ghostspeak or the Morytania legs 2+:

before-ghosts-ahoy.text: If the player is not wearing an amulet of ghostspeak or Morytania legs 2+:
If the player wears either an amulet of ghostspeak or the Morytania legs 2+:

steps.npc: Will you join with me and protest against the evil ban of Necrovarus and his disciples?

steps.player: I'm sorry, I don't really think I should get involved.

steps.npc: Ah, the youth of today - so apathetic to politics.

after-ghosts-ahoy.text: If the player is not wearing an amulet of ghostspeak or Morytania legs 2+:
If the player wears either an amulet of ghostspeak or the Morytania legs 2+:

steps.player: Why are you still protesting? I have commanded Necrovarus to let you and your friends do as you like! There's no need for this anymore!

steps.npc: There's always a need for a healthy interest in politics.

overhead-dialogue.npc: Rise up my fellow ghosts, and we shall be victorious!!
Rise together, Ghosts without a cause!!
United we conquer - divided we fall!!
Let Necrovarus know we want out!!
Don't stay silent - victory in numbers!!
